articles.title: Eight eMudhra CA Keys Compromised, Triggering Emergency Fixes Across Browsers and Software
articles.summary:
The private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate certificate authority (CA) certificates are compromised, Mozilla and Google's Chrome Root Program confirms on October 20.

articles.title: Hackers Use Autonomous AI Agents to Breach Company Websites, Target Over 1,200 Sites
articles.summary:

articles.title: Pegasus Spyware Infection Confirmed on Serbian University Rector's iPhone Days Before Election
articles.summary:

articles.title: WhatsApp Hid Instructions in Help Pages Telling Its AI Chatbot Not to Recommend Privacy Regulators
articles.summary:

articles.title: What Security Teams Can Do To Tame Wild Code
articles.summary: A sales manager builds an AI-assisted workflow to route leads. It connects to customer records, summarizes inbound requests, and posts updates to a shared channel. The workflow saves time, reduces manual work, and soon becomes part of the team’s daily routine. articles.title: Go Issues Emergency Update Blocking Eight CA Keys Over Undisclosed Security Concerns
articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Hijack Five OVHcloud CLI Releases to Distribute Secret-Stealing Malware
articles.summary:
An attacker used a contributor's GitHub account to replace the download archives on five existing releases of OVHcloud's command-line tool on Monday, October 19. The account had been hijacked, and the new files were a build designed to steal secrets stored on the disk of any machine that runs it, the cloud provider says.

They were live on GitHub for up to 94 minutes, from 12:47 to 14:21 UTC,
